description: This Java class `AjaxPageableResponse` extends `AjaxResponse` and is used to generate a JSON string representation of paginated data responses, including start and end row indices, total rows, and the data entries themselves.

classes.name: AjaxPageableResponse
classes.description: A Java class responsible for creating JSON responses with paginated data details, including paging info and data entries.

methods.name: getStartRow
methods.description: Returns the starting row index of the paginated data.

methods.name: setStartRow
methods.description: Sets the starting row index of the paginated data.

methods.name: getEndRow
methods.description: Returns the ending row index of the paginated data.

methods.name: setEndRow
methods.description: Sets the ending row index of the paginated data.

methods.name: getTotalRow
methods.description: Returns the total number of rows in the dataset.

methods.name: setTotalRow
methods.description: Sets the total number of rows in the dataset.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Converts the response data including paging info and data entries into a JSON string.
